title: When a Metaphor Becomes a Map
title_ja: 比喩が地図になるとき
fact_notes: 人物・出来事・制度は架空の教材例。実在の調査・統計・実証結果ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: In a fictional literature lesson, students examine several passages that describe learning as a journey through unfamiliar territory.
sentences.ja: 架空の文学授業で学びを未知の土地を旅することと表現した複数の文章を調べる。

sentences.en: The teacher asks why writers might describe a complicated intellectual activity using words normally associated with physical movement.
sentences.ja: 複雑な知的活動を通常は身体移動に関係する語で表す理由を尋ねる。

sentences.en: Several students suggest that references to paths, obstacles, and destinations make the process easier to imagine.
sentences.ja: 道、障害、目的地への言及で過程を想像しやすくなると数人が提案する。

sentences.en: Others wonder whether the comparison might also influence what readers expect learning to involve.
sentences.ja: 比較が学びに何を期待するかにも影響するのではないかと考える者もいる。

sentences.en: The students identify several assumptions that could accompany the metaphor even when they are not explicitly stated in the text.
sentences.ja: 本文に明示されなくても比喩に伴い得る前提を特定する。

sentences.en: A journey often suggests movement toward a particular destination, whereas learning sometimes involves changing the original goal after encountering new information.
sentences.ja: 旅は特定目的地への移動を示唆することが多いが学びは新情報に触れ元の目標を変える場合もある。

sentences.en: A path may also suggest that every learner should follow the same sequence of steps, although different approaches can sometimes lead to comparable understanding.
sentences.ja: 道は同じ手順を全学習者が踏むべきだと示唆する場合もあるが、異なる方法で同等の理解に至ることもある。

sentences.en: The teacher encourages the class to distinguish the usefulness of the comparison from the accuracy of every implication it might carry.
sentences.ja: 比較の有用性とそこから生じ得る全含意の正確さを区別するよう促す。

sentences.en: The class next examines a different metaphor in which learning is described as constructing a building.
sentences.ja: 次に学びを建物の建設と表す別の比喩を調べる。

sentences.en: This expression emphasizes the importance of foundations and suggests that later knowledge depends on relationships with earlier ideas.
sentences.ja: 基礎の重要性を強調し後の知識が以前の考えとの関係に依存すると示唆する。

sentences.en: However, it may encourage readers to imagine that established knowledge remains permanently fixed once it has been incorporated into the structure.
sentences.ja: しかし一度構造に組み込まれた知識は永久に固定されると想像させ得る。

sentences.en: The students discuss situations in which revising an earlier understanding would be essential rather than evidence that the entire process had failed.
sentences.ja: 以前の理解の修正が全過程の失敗の証拠でなく不可欠な状況を議論する。

sentences.en: For a writing exercise, each student selects an abstract concept and develops two different comparisons to describe it.
sentences.ja: 作文活動で各自が抽象概念を選び二つの異なる比較表現を作る。

sentences.en: They explain how each metaphor directs attention toward certain features while leaving other aspects of the concept less visible.
sentences.ja: 比喩が特定特徴に注意を向けながら他側面を見えにくくする様子を説明する。

sentences.en: The purpose is not to determine which comparison is universally correct, but to examine the kinds of reasoning that each comparison encourages.
sentences.ja: どの比較が普遍的に正しいか決めるのでなく各比較が促す推論の種類を検討することが目的だ。

sentences.en: The class discovers that switching between metaphors can help expose assumptions that were difficult to recognize within a single description.
sentences.ja: 比喩を切り替えると一つの記述内で認識しにくかった前提が見えることを知る。

sentences.en: Metaphorical language can make an unfamiliar subject accessible by connecting it with an experience that readers already understand.
sentences.ja: 比喩表現は読者が理解している経験と結び未知の主題を理解しやすくする。

sentences.en: Yet the resulting comparison may also shape the questions that readers consider worth asking about the subject.
sentences.ja: しかし比較はその主題について問う価値があると考える質問にも影響し得る。

sentences.en: Critical reading therefore includes examining what a metaphor makes easier to perceive and what it may encourage readers to overlook.
sentences.ja: 批判的読解には比喩が何を認識しやすくし何を見落とさせ得るかの検討が含まれる。

sentences.en: A metaphor is a valuable tool for thought precisely when its users recognize that it is not a complete description of reality.
sentences.ja: 比喩は現実の完全な記述ではないと利用者が認識するときこそ有益な思考道具になる。
